ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed Internet. Access to scanner capable of producing .pdf files required for exam submission. Wireless Internet is not recommended. No class during the week of Thanksgiving break (November 22nd). Asynchronous instruction - listed synchronous sessions are for class consultation and questions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
